title: Figma Plugin Phase 5 - Eliminate Magic Numbers
overview: Remove hardcoded magic numbers from Figma generators to ensure they stay in sync with component source code. All dimensional values should be derived from component-registry.json or centralized constants.

context.problem: Generators contain hardcoded magic numbers (widths, padding, gaps, font sizes, shadows) that could drift from actual component implementations. These values are duplicated across files and not derived from the source of truth.
context.current_state: Variant names and Tailwind classes are correctly read from registry, but dimensional values (SIZE_CONFIG, COMPACT_SIZE_MAP, STATE_STYLES, shadows) are hardcoded in individual generators.
context.why_now: Phase 4 (missing generator coverage) is COMPLETE. Next logical step is ensuring generators stay in sync with code changes automatically.

primary: Centralize all layout constants in shared.ts
Parse dimensional values from registry Tailwind classes where possible
Remove duplicate constant declarations across generators
Add shadow scale to shared.ts for Dialog and Tabs
Derive COMPACT_SIZE_MAP from Tailwind size-* classes
metrics: SIZE_CONFIG values derived from registry where possible
